text_block_list.name: Fans by the Stage
text_block_list.text: Suzukaaa! You can do it! <chrname>! I'm here to cheer for you!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sounds like we drew quite the crowd again.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes… and why wouldn't we? Wishes are, after all, explosive catalysts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hope attempts to peer into the possible, to discover the "what ifs?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But a wish wills the possible into being, augmenting potential with expectation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The masses, in their foolishness, fail to distinguish between the two, loading their own desires onto others.
choice_data_list: But that can be a source of power.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Are you going to get changed? It's almost time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, silly me! You truly are a pure soul.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But that is precisely why you are able to achieve pure growth… You have proven a most excellent sample.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname> and the other performers all gather by the stage, ready to go out for our fourth concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see them off into the spotlight with the wish that this will be yet another opportunity for them to grow.
